output.reason: [ev-dd988a5ed5c3] lists upgrading providers to v2 versions as step 4 of the upgrade approach. It also says existing cluster-scoped MRs continue working unchanged. Nowhere does it say what fails, or whether anything fails, if an operator keeps pre-v2 providers on Crossplane 2.0.0. The proposed claim that the update is needed "to ensure compatibility with Crossplane v2.0.0" is not in the evidence, so the mandatory migration-required kind is not supported. To decide the consequence, we need upstream text saying whether pre-v2 providers still work with Crossplane 2.0.0, or what breaks if they are not upgraded.
